רָעַם Ch. Tonare. Ithpeh אִתְרְעֵם, אִתְרַעַם Murmurare,
conqueri, obstrepere, tumultuari: Item Ele-
vari, attõlli, extolli. Aphel אַרְעִים Elevare, attollere, ex-
tollere, quomodo nonnunquam in Targ. Hierof.
respondet Hebraeo אֵרִים, ut Exo.14.16. Genef.39.18.
Unde male Num.20.11. in Venet. in 8° est אַרְעָב, pro
וֵירִם, quod proin in Basil. correctum.
רְעַם emph. רַעְמָא Ch.& Syr. Tonitru.
Syr. Querela, ad Coloss.3.13.
תּוּרְעַמְתָּא, תּוּרְעַמְתָּא & תִּרְעוּמְתָּא Ch. Murmur, murmuratio,
querela: Plur. תִּרְעוּמָתָא, Jesa.29.6. & תּוּרְעַמְתָּא.
רַעֲנָן Ch. Virens, viridis, וְרַעֲנָן בְּהֵיכְלִי Et virens in
palatio meo, Dan.4.1.
רַעַע Ch. Frangere, confringere, conterere, coquas-
sare, ab Hebr. רַצַּץ litteris ʒ & y permutatis. Ex
Pahel Partic. מְרַעַע Quod confringit.
רְעִיעַ Ch. Concussus, quassatus, coquassatus. Plur. רְעִיעִין.
Fœmin. רְעִיעָתָא Concussa, Psal.62.4.
רָעֵץ Ch. Frangere, confringere. Partic. וְהֵוָא רָעֵץ Et
erat franges, Exo.2.21. in Targ. Jon. Affine רָצִיץ.
אִירְעֵצָא Vide in עֵרֶץ.
רַעַת Aphel Part. Syr. ܐܪܥܐ Discerpit, lacerat, quas-
sat, conquassat, Græce ἀφεἰζων, spumans, Luc.9.39.
Mar.9.18.20. Convenit cum præced. רָעַץ, ʒ & ת in-
ter se permutatis, vel Heb. רָעַשׁ.
רָפָה Hebr. Remittere, remissum esse. Aphel ܐܦܐܢ
Syr. Remittere, dimittere, laxare. Ithpahel Ch.
